title: Join all lines of a file into a single line
summary: Combine every line of a text file into one long line, separated by tabs or a custom character. Useful for creating CSVs or single-line logs from multi-line data.

steps.explain: Use the `paste` command with the serial flag to merge all lines of a file into a single line, using a tab as the default separator.

placeholders.name: FILE
placeholders.description: Path to the text file you want to join

alternatives.explain: Use a custom delimiter instead of a tab to separate the joined lines.

placeholders.name: DELIMITER
placeholders.description: The character to use between joined lines
